explication: Garnet is a RESP-compatible remote cache-store. The principal workflow is: an application uses a Garnet client, the server accepts and parses RESP commands, authenticates and dispatches them, storage sessions execute operations against Tsavorite-backed databases, and responses return through the same network path. Major branches include transactions, durability and tiered devices, object/vector/range features, extensibility, and passive clustered sharding, migration, gossip, and replication. Some subsystem links reflect README capabilities because their implementations were not sampled directly.
